transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess I’m here because work has been… harder to shake off lately. The district added this bilingual social-emotional learning rollout on top of my regular teaching, and I’m managing, but I feel more wound up and discouraged than I usually do. I’ve also been putting off lesson plans and emails that I used to just handle.
Are you still enjoying the things you used to like doing?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t thought about it that way. Some things still feel okay, I guess… I just don’t always get around to them.
Are there things that you used to enjoy, but no longer find pleasure in?
I don’t think so… not clearly. I mean, I haven’t really been doing as much, but I wouldn’t say things feel totally empty or anything. I just sort of… don’t always make time for them.
Have you been feeling anxious lately?

Yes… I think so. Since that bilingual social-emotional learning rollout got added on top of everything else, I’ve been more wound up than usual. I still get through the day, but I feel discouraged, and I’ve started putting off lesson plans and emails I used to just handle.
Have you been feeling sad or down most of the time lately?

Most of the time… I don’t know if I’d call it sad, exactly. Since that district rollout got added onto my regular teaching, I’ve just felt more discouraged and wound up than like myself. I’m still getting through the day, but it’s been harder.
Have you noticed any change in your weight lately?
Not really. I haven’t noticed anything significant with my weight.
Are you avoiding certain situations or tasks because they make you feel anxious?

Yes… I guess I have been. Mostly with lesson plans and emails. Since that bilingual social-emotional learning rollout got added on top of my regular teaching, I still do what I have to, but I’ll put those things off now in a way I didn’t used to. It just makes me feel wound up.
Have you been having any repetitive thoughts or behaviors that you feel compelled to do?
No… I don’t think so. I mean, I may go over things in my head, but not like I feel forced to do something over and over.
Are there things that you used to enjoy that now feel completely empty or uninteresting to you?
No… I don’t think completely empty. I still enjoy things, maybe I’m just a bit more tired or distracted sometimes.
Have you lost interest in activities that you usually find enjoyable?
Not really. I still like the things I usually like… I just may not get to them as much, or I’m a little preoccupied.
Have you been feeling guilty about anything lately?
Not especially, no. I mean… I wonder if I could handle some things better, but I wouldn’t say I’m feeling guilty.
Do you often find yourself worrying about the future?

Yes… mostly about school, I guess. Since the district added this bilingual social-emotional learning rollout on top of my regular teaching, I’ve been worrying about keeping up. I still get through the day, but I feel more wound up and discouraged than usual. Some lesson plans and emails I’d normally just handle, I’ve been putting off.
Have you been feeling more tired than usual lately?
A little, maybe. It’s hard to tell… I’ve been getting through my day, but by the end I do feel pretty worn out.
Do you feel like your anxiety is interfering with your daily life?
Some, yes. I’m still teaching and taking care of the basics, but… I’ve let a few planning deadlines slide, and colleagues have had to remind me about things I used to just get done on my own.
Do you feel like you're able to experience a full range of emotions like you used to?
I… I’m not sure. I don’t think I’ve noticed anything like that exactly. I still feel things, just maybe I don’t pay as much attention to it lately.
Do you feel like you're as emotionally responsive to things as you used to be?
I don’t really know. I guess I still react to things… maybe I’m just a bit more distracted lately. I haven’t noticed a big change.
Do you feel like things that used to upset you or make you angry don't have as much of an effect on you anymore?
I don’t think so… I still get upset by the usual things. Maybe I don’t always show it as much, but I haven’t really noticed them affecting me less.
Do you feel like you're less able to feel emotions like happiness or excitement than you used to?
I don’t think so. I mean… I can still feel happy about things. Maybe I’m not paying attention to it as much lately, but I wouldn’t say I can’t feel excitement or anything like that.
Do you feel like you're unable to feel emotions as strongly as you used to?
I’m not sure I’d say unable. I still feel things… maybe not always as intensely in the moment, but I haven’t really noticed a big change.
Do you feel like you're unable to cry or experience strong emotions when you normally would?
I don’t think so. I mean, I can still cry if I’m really upset… and I still feel things strongly sometimes. I haven’t noticed being unable to.
